summary: Made the my-console-runner skill portable: browser-open now branches on uname (open on Darwin, xdg-open otherwise) and the server-detach drops setsid, keeping nohup & with pid capture. Refreshed the cursor copy via link-skills.sh, verified the opencode stub and symlinks follow the source, and smoke-proved a Linux launch end to end (detached start, /api/state answers, xdg-open exits 0). Committed in the skills repo; the Mac branch remains to be proven on Billy's next Mac run.
